Built from the Task 10 proof Mike signed 2026-11-15 (C2/headline.txt): old release orion-2026.11.12.1 before any chain price vs this branch after backfill-prices, reprice, rebuild-price-levels and both purges, on the prod copy, report days 2026-11-13 and 2026-08-14 (26 reports).

Every numeric path that differed there has one exact-path entry per asset: rel = 2x the measured max |rel| over both days (rounded up to 3 significant figures); growth.change / growth.annualized / yields.pegTrailing / unreconciled.* use abs = 2x the measured max |abs| (their base can be near or cross zero). Five float-noise paths (measured rel <= 3.4e-16) are floored at rel 1e-12.
Text: priceBasis.flows (every asset, `*`), priceBasis.source / sourceType and each line's priceBasis are value-pinned to the proof's exact old/new (fail closed on any other value).
Token amounts, supply, grades and every non-USD field get no entry (none differed). AERO's only difference was the shared priceBasis.flows text, so it has no entry of its own. No todo placeholders.

*.old: each flow day's USD from its tokens x hourly prices where every hour is priced and the stored value was itself hourly-priced at ingest (the G2-signed days), else the stored value (per line: priceBasis)
*.new: each flow day's USD from its tokens x the chain/first-party hourly prices where every hour with an amount is priced (hourly), or its day amount x the mean of the day's 24 chain hours (daily_mean), else the stored value (per line: priceBasis)
*.reason: R2: the report's flow pricing text names the chain/first-party hourly view (flow_usd_chain_v: hourly or daily_mean) instead of the ingest-time hourly gate (Task 5); same old/new text on all 13 assets in the proof
